SABER College Accreditation and Regulatory Approvals

SABER College Accreditation highlights the institution’s dedication to providing high-quality, career-focused education that meets both national and state standards. Located in Miami, Florida, SABER College operates as a not-for-profit institution under 501(c)(3) status. Its mission centers on expanding access to education, particularly in the healthcare field, while supporting students through quality instruction, experienced faculty, and personalized support services.

SABER College is licensed by the Florida Department of Education Commission for Independent Education (CIE). This licensure confirms the college’s authorization to operate as a postsecondary institution in the State of Florida and ensures that its academic programs, instructional staff, facilities, and institutional policies meet the required state guidelines. Being licensed by CIE provides transparency, accountability, and credibility for students and families seeking a trusted educational institution.

In addition to state licensure, SABER College Accreditation includes institutional accreditation from the Council on Occupational Education (COE). COE is a national accrediting agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education and operates under the Higher Education Act of 1965. This accreditation validates the overall quality of SABER College’s academic programs, governance, student services, learning outcomes, and financial practices. Accreditation from COE assures students that SABER College operates with integrity and adheres to high academic and professional standards. For more information about COE, please visit www.council.org.

SABER College also holds programmatic accreditation for its Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) Program through the Commission on Accreditation in Physical Therapy Education (CAPTE). This accreditation ensures that the PTA program is aligned with the standards required to train competent, ethical, and skilled physical therapist assistants. CAPTE is the only accrediting agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education for physical therapy education. Its rigorous review process evaluates program content, faculty qualifications, clinical experiences, student outcomes, and institutional support.

CAPTE is located at 3030 Potomac Avenue, Suite 100, Alexandria, Virginia 22305-3085. For inquiries, CAPTE may be contacted by phone at 703-706-3245, by email at accreditation@apta.org, or by visiting www.capteonline.org. Individuals who wish to file a formal complaint about the PTA program are encouraged to follow SABER College’s internal grievance policy and due process procedures first. If further action is needed, CAPTE may be contacted using the information provided above. To reach the program or institution directly, call 305-443-9170 or email karocha@sabercollege.edu.

Another important element of SABER College Accreditation is its designation as a Title IV eligible institution by the U.S. Department of Education. This approval allows qualified students to apply for federal financial aid, including Pell Grants and student loans. Participation in Title IV programs reflects the institution’s compliance with federal financial aid regulations and enhances access to postsecondary education for students who require financial assistance to pursue their academic and professional goals.

SABER College is also approved to offer educational services through Vocational Rehabilitation programs. These programs provide specialized support for students with disabilities or other qualifying conditions, ensuring they receive the guidance, resources, and accommodations needed to succeed in their chosen field. This approval further strengthens the college’s ability to serve a diverse student population and expand pathways to employment for individuals facing additional challenges.

SABER College Accreditation plays a central role in building confidence among students, families, employers, and regulators. It reflects the college’s dedication to educational quality, student support, and continuous improvement. Whether students enroll in Nursing, PTA, or VESL programs, they can expect a learning environment that meets or exceeds the standards set by accrediting agencies and professional organizations.
To learn more about SABER College Accreditation, available programs, or the admissions process, we invite you to contact our team directly.

Net Price Calculator

The Net Price Calculator at SABER College is an essential tool that helps prospective students and their families estimate the cost of attending college. Understanding tuition, fees, and potential financial aid is one of the most important steps in planning for your education. SABER College is committed to transparency and accessibility, providing this federally required tool to support informed financial decision-making.

This calculator offers an early look at your estimated net cost—the difference between the total cost of attendance and any non-loan financial aid you may be eligible to receive. Using historical data and the information you provide, the tool delivers a personalized estimate tailored to your unique circumstances. While it does not replace the official financial aid process, it serves as a valuable resource for financial planning.
What Is the Net Price Calculator?

The Net Price Calculator is designed for undergraduate students exploring enrollment at SABER College. It allows you to estimate your likely education costs after grant and scholarship aid, based on a combination of federal formulas and previous year institutional data.

Though not an official financial offer, the results offer insight into what similar students paid in prior years—giving you a better sense of affordability before you complete your FAFSA or submit an application. This is just one of the ways SABER College supports students in preparing for higher education.
Why Use the Net Price Calculator?
Selecting the right college is a significant decision—both personally and financially. The Net Price Calculator gives you the clarity needed to:

[{"text":"Understand possible out-of-pocket expenses","_id":"3f34ea3"},{"text":"Preview the impact of financial aid packages","_id":"7dfc2a1"},{"text":"Begin planning realistically for your educational investment","_id":"bda1fee"}]
This tool is particularly useful for those pursuing Gainful Employment programs at SABER College, including our Nursing, Physical Therapist Assistant and healthcare training programs.
Whether you're a recent high school graduate or a working adult returning to school, this resource helps you make a more confident and informed choice.
How to Use It

Using the calculator is quick and straightforward. In about 5–10 minutes, you’ll answer a few basic questions about income, household size, and dependency status. Based on your answers, the tool will generate an estimate of your net price—the cost of attendance minus average financial aid.

Keep in mind, the more accurate the information you enter, the more closely your estimate will reflect your potential financial aid eligibility. While the calculator cannot predict every detail, it provides a useful baseline for budgeting and comparison.
Need Help?

If you need help understanding your results or want to speak with someone about your options, SABER College offers support through our Financial Aid Office. Our experienced staff can guide you through the FAFSA, help you understand financial aid eligibility, and answer questions related to tuition and payment planning.

Gainful Employment Programs at SABER College

SABER College offers federally recognized Gainful Employment programs designed to prepare students for careers in nursing, physical therapy, and allied health fields. In accordance with U.S. Department of Education regulations, institutions like SABER College are required to disclose specific facts about these programs to help prospective students make informed decisions about their education and career path.

These disclosures include details such as program duration, occupational outcomes, typical student loan debt, and graduation or job placement data. They are intended to ensure that students understand both the academic commitment and career possibilities associated with each program before enrolling.

Under 34 CFR § 668.6, the federal government requires institutions of higher education to share program-level facts for all eligible gainful employment programs. These disclosures provide answers to key questions such as:

[{"text":"How long does the program take to complete?","_id":"3f34ea3"},{"text":"What types of careers can I pursue upon graduation?","_id":"d1ff6fd"},{"text":"What is the typical loan debt for program graduates?","_id":"1cd64bb"},{"text":"What are the job placement and completion outcomes?","_id":"e4ce242"}]
This level of transparency empowers students to compare similar programs across colleges and choose the option that best fits their personal goals and financial situation.
Gainful Employment Programs at SABER College
The following Associate of Science degree programs at SABER College are designated as gainful employment programs:
1. Associate of Science – Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA)

This program prepares students to assist licensed physical therapists in delivering rehabilitative care. Graduates are equipped to work in hospitals, outpatient centers, and long-term care facilities.
2. Associate of Science – Professional Nursing Program (PNP)

SABER College’s Nursing program prepares students to sit for the NCLEX-RN and begin professional practice as Registered Nurses. Graduates work in a wide range of healthcare environments including hospitals, clinics, and community care centers.
